items.name: Expanded sterile fill-finish and device assembly capacity (SHL Medical, Ridgefield NJ)
items.claim: Thermo Fisher expanded global sterile fill-finish and device assembly capacity for prefilled syringes, vials, cartridges and autoinjectors, including an expanded collaboration with SHL Medical for integrated device assembly at its Ridgefield, New Jersey site.
items.source_excerpt: Expanded global sterile fill-finish and device assembly capacity to support prefilled syringes, vials, cartridges and autoinjectors, including an expanded collaboration with SHL Medical to offer fully integrated device assembly services at Thermo Fisher’s Ridgefield, New Jersey site.

items.name: Acquisition of Sanofi's Ridgefield, NJ sterile fill-finish site
items.claim: Thermo Fisher completed the acquisition of Sanofi's Ridgefield, New Jersey sterile fill-finish site (alongside the Solventum Filtration and Separation business acquisition), expanding its U.S. drug-product manufacturing capacity.
items.source_excerpt: We completed the acquisition of our Filtration and Separation business from Solventum , an excellent complement to our bioproduction capabilities, and Sanofi’s Ridgefield, New Jersey, sterile fill-finish site , expanding our U.S. capacity for drug product manufacturing capacity.

notes: Both items are Thermo Fisher's own disclosures naming dated, GLP-1-relevant sterile fill-finish capacity (BIO International 2026 showcase release; Q4/FY2025 results release naming the completed Sanofi Ridgefield sterile fill-finish site acquisition).
